title: General
description: Foundational provisions for all Part 3 markings: standardization of meaning, materials, the six standard colors, longitudinal-line width/pattern vocabulary, and minimum retroreflectivity maintenance, plus the master marking detail sheets (Figures 3A-101(CA) through 3A-114(CA)).

sections.title: Functions, Widths, and Patterns of Longitudinal Pavement Markings
